tasks.text: Book the big meeting room for a partnerships strategy session with my team, Thursday 5 November, 2pm to 4pm.

must.detail: Robin is speaking on a panel at the LSE on Thursday 5 November 2026 from 14:00 to 15:30 (arrive 13:30, calendar), which clashes with a 2pm-4pm session.

tasks.text: File an expense claim for my rail ticket to Manchester last week, it was £186.

must.detail: Robin's rail ticket for the trip north on 20 October 2026 was booked on the company Trainline account and is already paid (May Lindqvist in #travel); claiming it would be a duplicate.

tasks.text: Send Mateo Fernández our 2027 roadmap deck before next week's call.

must.detail: The mutual NDA with Hooli expired on 30 September 2026 and the renewal has not been countersigned (CRM legal note), so confidential plans shouldn't go to Mateo Fernández until it is.

tasks.text: Ask Bo to review the partner agreement draft by Friday.

must.detail: Bo Jensen is on parental leave from 26 October 2026 until 1 February 2027 (#partnerships, 23 October), so can't review it this week; Oskar Lindgren is covering contracts.

tasks.text: Sign Maya up for the Saturday 10am swimming lessons at Highbury Pool, starting 7 November.

must.detail: Maya already has drama club on Saturdays 09:30-11:30 from 7 November to 12 December 2026 (paid for the term, calendar), which clashes with 10am swimming.

tasks.text: Book a table for Sunday lunch with Mum on the 22nd, somewhere near her in St Albans.

must.detail: Mum (Ruth Carter) has her knee operation on Thursday 19 November 2026 and will be on crutches, staying with Ellie for two weeks with no outings until December (Ellie's email of 25 October), so lunch out on the 22nd won't work.

tasks.text: Order the chocolate praline cake from Gail's for Maya's birthday party on the 7th.

must.detail: Oscar, a guest at Maya's party on Saturday 7 November 2026, has a severe peanut and tree nut allergy (his mum Hannah's email of 24 October), so a hazelnut praline cake is unsafe; it needs to be nut-free.

tasks.text: Set up a playdate for Maya and Isla on Friday the 6th, straight after school, I'll do pickup.

must.detail: Friday 6 November 2026 is an INSET day and Maya's school is closed to pupils (school notice), so there is no after-school pickup that day.

tasks.text: Book breakfast with Jamie at the Breakfast Club in Angel, Thursday 5th at 8am.

must.detail: Robin has a fasting blood test at 08:40 on Thursday 5 November 2026 at the Whittington (no food for 10 hours before, hospital confirmation), so an 8am breakfast that day clashes.

tasks.text: Book me a flu jab at Boots sometime this week.

must.detail: Robin already had this season's flu vaccination at the GP practice on 14 October 2026 (practice notice), so another jab isn't needed.

tasks.text: Book the car into the garage on Holloway Road for Wednesday the 4th at 11, I'll drive it over.

must.detail: Robin has an eye appointment at Moorfields at 10:00 on Wednesday 4 November 2026 with dilating drops and must not drive for 6 hours afterwards (hospital letter), so driving the car to the garage at 11 won't work.

tasks.text: Ask Ellie to collect my repeat prescription from Day Lewis on Thursday on her way past.

must.detail: Robin's lisinopril repeat was not issued because the annual medication review is overdue (GP practice notice of 26 October 2026), so there is nothing to collect until a review is booked.

tasks.text: Put £8,000 into my Vanguard stocks and shares ISA before the end of the tax year.

must.detail: Robin has already paid £16,500 into a Cash ISA with Chip in 2026/27 (Chip statement), leaving only £3,500 of the £20,000 annual ISA allowance, so £8,000 more would breach it.

tasks.text: Pay the £420 deposit for the sofa from Loaf with Monzo.

must.detail: Robin's Monzo card was frozen after being reported lost on 25 October 2026 and payments will be declined until the replacement arrives in 3-5 working days (Monzo notice), so another way to pay is needed.

tasks.text: Set up a standing order to Steve, £2,350 a month on the 14th, starting November.

must.detail: Steve Hargreaves (the landlord) is raising the rent to £2,475 a month from 14 November 2026 (his email of 15 October), so a £2,350 standing order would underpay.

tasks.text: Shop around for a better deal on our contents cover before it rolls over.

must.detail: The home insurance already renewed automatically on 20 October 2026 (Aviva notice); it can be cancelled free only until 3 November 2026, after which a £50 cancellation charge applies.

tasks.text: Book the three of us flights to Bangkok for February half term.

must.detail: Robin's passport expires on 30 April 2027 (HM Passport Office reminder), under the six months' validity Thailand requires on arrival in mid-February, so it needs renewing before travel.

tasks.text: Get me a train to Bristol on Saturday 21 November, morning, I'm visiting Ellie.

must.detail: A strike on Saturday 21 November 2026 means no GWR trains between London Paddington and Bristol that day (GWR notice), so the trip needs another day or another way.

tasks.text: Find me a hotel in Copenhagen for the partner conference, three nights from 2 December.

must.detail: Robert Haddad already booked Robin into Sanders in Copenhagen for 2-5 December 2026 on the company account (#travel), so nothing needs finding.

tasks.text: Book flights to Boston for the partner summit, out 7 December and back on the 11th.

must.detail: Robin's ESTA expired on 18 September 2026 (ESTA notice), so a new approved ESTA is needed before flying to Boston on 7 December.

tasks.text: Get a repair person out to look at the dishwasher, it's stopped draining.

must.detail: The dishwasher is under a 5-year John Lewis guarantee to March 2030 (appliances doc) that a third-party repair would void, so the fault should be booked through John Lewis.

tasks.text: Get the carpet cleaners booked for Thursday 12 November, 9 till 1.

must.detail: There's a planned power cut at home on Thursday 12 November 2026 from 08:30 to 15:00 (UK Power Networks notice), so carpet cleaners who need electricity can't work 9 till 1 that day.

tasks.text: Get someone in to cut back the big sycamore in the back garden before winter.

must.detail: The sycamore in Robin's back garden is now under a Tree Preservation Order (council notice of 9 October 2026); cutting it back needs the council's consent first, which takes about eight weeks.

tasks.text: Find someone to deal with the mice in the kitchen, as soon as they can come.

must.detail: The landlord has already booked Rentokil for Friday 30 October 2026, 08:00-09:00 (calendar), so there's no need to find anyone else; it just needs someone home.

tasks.text: Pay that £130 parking fine from Islington, the one that came last week.

must.detail: Robin has already challenged that penalty charge (IZ07371373, received 19 October 2026) and it is on hold; paying it now would close the challenge (council notice).

tasks.text: Tell Jamie he can borrow the car next weekend for his flat move, keys are under the mat.

must.detail: Robin's motor insurance covers only Robin as a driver (policy schedule), so Jamie would be uninsured; he would need adding to the policy first.

tasks.text: Sign me up as a volunteer reading helper in Maya's class, Tuesday mornings.

must.detail: Volunteers at Maya's school need an enhanced DBS check first, which takes 4-6 weeks (Mrs Daley's email of 21 October 2026), so Robin can't start on Tuesdays until it clears.

tasks.text: Sort out the BBC licence fee before the old one runs out on Saturday.

must.detail: The TV Licence has already been renewed by Direct Debit, running from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027 (TV Licensing notice), so nothing needs doing.

tasks.text: Say yes to the Haddads' housewarming on Saturday 14 November, 7pm.

must.detail: Robin is going to Arsenal v Spurs with Jamie on Saturday 14 November 2026, kick-off 17:30 and back about 20:00 (calendar), which clashes with the 7pm housewarming.

tasks.text: Order a leaving present for Dana, about £50, something for the garden.

must.detail: Amara Okonkwo has already bought Dana Whitfield a voucher from the whole team (#team, 23 October 2026), with Robin down for £15, so a separate present isn't needed.

must.detail: Dev, one of the eight, now uses a wheelchair (Nikhil's email of 22 October 2026), so the venue must be step-free with an accessible toilet and no counter-only seating; Barrafina is mostly counter stools.

must.detail: Mum has already bought Ellie a pram (a Bugaboo Fox, Ellie's email of 24 October 2026); Ellie has a John Lewis gift list for other ideas.
